findings.issue: Plain rendering allowed markerless user bodies to emit host-owned marker syntax.
findings.resolution: User content now has a host-owned envelope and is escaped; adversarial user, skill and retrieved bodies are tested in plain and structured layouts.

findings.issue: The compiler fixture proved only serde round-trip, not parser/compiler/emitter propagation for a template-only declaration.
findings.resolution: The fixture now parses a template-only prompt section, compiles it, and asserts schema v2 plus the exact emitted payload identifier.

findings.issue: Blank destination and profile identities or revisions could compare equal and resolve.
findings.resolution: Typed destination/profile identity validation now runs before matching, with blank exact, family, profile and destination revision regressions.
